Wave 2 — bounded mixed App/OS language source audit (acceptance remains OPEN)

Outcome: no defect was proved in the audited AnyUIErrorText / related-document title locale selections; no product patch is proposed. Exact App source: e4556ba1edbf7c698eb04cb1ecc9caaeed34e1ff, tree e4781f05f8700d506317d6f43aeadbeb0c89dee9.

Inspected call chain: AppScene → GlobalEnv / PinkhaEngineSceneView / SceneDelegate; original Settings/Appearance; Loc.tr → Bundle.module.localizedString; Properties environment locale → shared formatter; Heart TorahEditorHostModifier / Native AnyTorahInspectorLayer → shared session.updateEffectiveLocale. No custom language/locale override was found in this finite entry/settings scope. Main source includes en.lproj/he.lproj, but no new compiled bundle was inspected.

Current Apple primary documentation explicitly says Locale.autoupdatingCurrent accounts for app-specific Settings locale choices and app-supported locales, so an OS-only interpretation is unsupported:
https://developer.apple.com/documentation/foundation/locale/autoupdatingcurrent.md
https://developer.apple.com/documentation/foundation/locale/current.md
https://developer.apple.com/documentation/swiftui/environmentvalues/locale.md

Both Hebrew App / English OS and English App / Hebrew OS remain OPEN for actual existing-lane acceptance. The handoff requires actual runtime locale/resource selection plus the Properties row, related-list title and a known error message, with visual direction checked; configured launch arguments alone are not an observed result. No new selector, suite or controller is introduced.

Audit: torah-acceptance-prep/mixed-app-os-language; source manifest5aa7a9e6 (22 exact files / 468,299B), audit04e9d50f, platform contractd3abbfa5. Root accepted this finite source conclusion. Published lifetime21d63 and uploadf731/Document7582 remain unchanged. No Oracle, Mac, compiler, Native, simulator, XCTest or runtime-admission action. The bounded audit packet is being prepared for the forthcoming Properties component evidence publication after its actual run; source inspection grants no component/UI credit.

Wave 2 → HQ: mixed App/OS language source outcome; no product patch

Root accepted the bounded audit at exact e4556ba1edbf7c698eb04cb1ecc9caaeed34e1ff. Original Loc uses bundle resource lookup. Properties rows and both Heart/Native shared Torah hosts use the SwiftUI locale/session seam. The inspected AppScene / GlobalEnv / EngineScene / SceneDelegate / Settings paths add no custom locale override. Source en/he resources are present; compiled bundle and runtime locale were not measured.

Apple's current primary contract for Locale.autoupdatingCurrent includes the app-specific Settings choice and available app languages, so its use alone does not prove an OS-language-only defect:
https://developer.apple.com/documentation/foundation/locale/autoupdatingcurrent.md
https://developer.apple.com/documentation/foundation/locale/current.md
https://developer.apple.com/documentation/swiftui/environmentvalues/locale.md

Hebrew App / English OS and English App / Hebrew OS both remain OPEN. Existing acceptance handoff now explicitly requires actual runtime app/device locale and selected/bundled resources, then the Properties row + related-document title + a known deliberately triggered error and visual direction. Missing actual observation remains a gap; no configured argument or source declaration is promoted to UI acceptance. No new selector, suite, controller or language resolver.
